articles.headline: NFL Week 10 uniforms: Titans debut Rivalries look, Ravens go all-black
articles.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 10, led by the Tennessee Titans' Rivalries look.
articles.headlineJa: NFL第10週のユニフォーム：タイタンズが「ライバルズ・ルック」を初披露、レイブンズはオールブラック
articles.descriptionJa: テネシー・タイタンズの「ライバルズ・ルック」を筆頭に、NFL各チームの第10週のユニフォームをご紹介します。
articles.body:
The NFL regular season has officially passed the halfway point, meaning we are approaching the final chances to see threads on the field. Thankfully, the uniform heat isn't stopping any time soon as alternates continue to make headlines around the league. This week, it's the Tennessee Titans' turn as they debut their Rivalries look.

Tennessee will wear its "Music City"-inspired combination against the Jacksonville Jaguars. It includes a two-tone blue color palette with a Titans-blue lid and navy uniform. The numbers are reminiscent of a neon sign, a nod to those that run through Nashville. "Music City" runs across the chest, while six rhythmic stripes run down the side, similar to strings on a guitar. 

It's a fresh look for the Baltimore Ravens, too, who will debut their all-black combination against the Los Angeles Chargers on "Monday Night Football." The headline for Baltimore's threads is a new matte black lid, nicknamed the "Darkness Helmet." It includes black talon stripes and a two-toned Ravens logo that features red eyes. The shield shoulder patch is black and midnight purple, while "darkness there and nothing more" runs on the inside collar -- a reference to a quote from Edgar Allen Poe's "The Raven."

Monochromatic alternates are popular around the rest of the league. The Cincinnati Bengals will wear their "White Bengal" helmet with all-white uniforms, first introduced in 2022, against the Pittsburgh Steelers. Cincinnati has gone 5-1 in the white helmets since they debuted in 2022. The New York Jets are rocking the "Legacy Black" threads against the Buffalo Bills, while the New Orleans Saints will also go all-black against the Carolina Panthers. It's "Alpha Dawg" week for the Cleveland Browns, who will don all-brown against the Houston Texans.

Fans of nostalgia aren't leaving empty-handed. The San Francisco 49ers are wearing their red 1994 throwback threads against the Dallas Cowboys on the road for a classic uniform matchup. Thursday night has the New York Giants rocking their vintage white look against the Washington Commanders for the final time this season.

articles.headline: The Bills visit the Jets with a 7-1 record and a chance at their best start since 1991
articles.description: — The Buffalo Bills are off to their best start in 33 years, Josh Allen and the high-scoring offense are clicking, and they're tied for the top...
articles.headlineJa: 7勝1敗の成績でジェッツを訪問するビルズ、1991年以来最高のスタートを切る好機
articles.descriptionJa: — バッファロー・ビルズは33年で最高のスタートを切っており、ジョシュ・アレン率いる高得点攻撃陣が噛み合い、首位タイに位置しています...
articles.body:
EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. -- — The Buffalo Bills are off to their best start in 33 years, Josh Allen and the high-scoring offense are clicking, and they're tied for the top record in the NFL.


              In a season during which many things have gone right so far, the Bills know better than to overlook a struggling AFC East rival when they face the New York Jets on Sunday at MetLife Stadium. 


              “This is a division game on the road, it’s going to be as hard as it gets, right?” first-year coach Joe Brady said. “We showed that we can go on the road and win a hard game. We've got to go do it again.


              “And if we think otherwise, then I’m not doing a good enough job.”


              Coming off a 23-6 victory at Minnesota on Monday night, Buffalo is 7-1 — tops in the AFC and tied for the NFL lead with San Francisco. It's the first time since 1993 the Bills have opened a season 7-1 or better. A win over the Jets (2-7) — who they've beaten in their past five meetings — would give them their best start since 1991, when they began 10-1 on the way to a second straight Super Bowl appearance.


              “We know we’re always going to get everybody’s best, as we should,” Brady said. “And we’re going to have to bring it to be able to come out with a win. We know it’s not going to be easy, but we wouldn’t want it any other way.”


              The Bills lead the NFL in total yards and points per game, with their 256 points through eight games ranking as the third most by a team with a first-year head coach in the Super Bowl era, trailing only the Mike Martz-coached 2000 St. Louis Rams (330) and Sean McVay-coached 2017 Los Angeles Rams (263).


              It would seem the ultimate mismatch for a team struggling as badly as the Jets, who have dropped four in a row, have a coach in Aaron Glenn sitting on a blazing hot seat and a slumping, underperforming defense.


              But of New York's seven losses, just two have been by more than one score, including its 35-12 defeat last Sunday at Kansas City. That has Glenn and the Jets hopeful they can stave off stretching the franchise's postseason drought to 16 straight seasons. 


              “Listen, there’s a number of things that we've got to fix and get better at, but we feel like, man, we’re right on the cusp of trying to break through and we’re going to do everything we can to do that,” Glenn said. "And that’s my responsibility. ... I just have to continue to really look hard at what we’re doing to make sure that we get ourselves over that hump to start winning these games.”


              Need to know
              Buffalo (7-1) at New York Jets (2-7)


              When/where to watch: Sunday, 1 p.m. EST, CBS.


              Latest odds: Bills by 7 1/2.


              Against the spread: Bills 6-2; Jets 3-5-1.


              Last week: Bills beat Vikings 23-6; Jets lost to Chiefs 35-12.


              Last meeting: Bills won 35-8 on Jan. 4, 2026

articles.headline: A big Munich test for the Lions and Patriots as injuries loom for New England
articles.description: — Heading into international games, NFL coaches typically talk up the niceties of “growing the game” globally.
articles.headlineJa: ライオンズとペイトリオッツにミュンヘンでの大きな試練、ニューイングランドには負傷者の懸念も
articles.descriptionJa: — インターナショナル・ゲームに向けて、NFLのコーチたちは通常、世界的に「競技を広める」ことの意義について語ります。
articles.body:
MUNICH -- — Heading into international games, NFL coaches typically talk up the niceties of “growing the game” globally.


              Not this week.


              The New England Patriots (5-4) have lost two of their past three games and have a slew of injury concerns, including running back Rhamondre Stevenson. The Detroit Lions, even with a 6-2 record and four straight victories, are trying to keep pace in the tight NFC North.


              Sunday's game in Munich is a big one for both teams.


              Lions coach Dan Campbell wasn't focused on the international implications.


              “Well, if I’m being honest, I just haven’t thought that far into it. I’m like, ‘We’ve got to get prepared,’” Campbell said.


              The Patriots were embarrassed at home by the Green Bay Packers last week, losing 45-27, with Drake Maye throwing three interceptions and the secondary struggling to contain the Packers passing game.


              Campbell expects a much-improved New England team on Sunday.


              “You look at the totality of what this team is capable of, the firepower they have, and they’re a good team. They’re dangerous,” he said. “And they’re going to clean a lot of things up.”


              The Lions slogged through a 19-9 win over the rebuilding Miami Dolphins last week, relying on four field goals from Jake Bates. It was also just one week after a neck injury to All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell.


              Detroit's bye week is in the rearview mirror and after Munich the team will host Tampa Bay and then Chicago on Thanksgiving Day.


              “It's a good thing to be tested during the season,” Campbell said. "It really is. And to have to go through some of these tough stretches because that’s what the playoffs are. That’s what it is. And certainly if you got to go on the road. So, that’s what this is. This is about us. This is the next obstacle we have. Told the team we’re not going to clear it. Our objective is to go through it and that’s the mindset.”


              Injuries are a top concern for New England. Before traveling Wednesday night, the Patriots ruled out LG Ben Brown (knee), CB Carlton Davis III (knee) and RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness).


              Stevenson, the team's leading rusher with 399 yards on 102 carries, didn't practice Wednesday because of a knee injury.


              That could put second-year running back Corey Kiner in line for the bulk of the carries.


              “Corey has done a really nice job, but there are also some things that Corey has to be able to improve on,” coach Mike Vrabel said, citing "recognition of the pressure and then the ability to block the pressure.”

articles.headline: 76ers Joel Embiid (foot) questionable, LeBron James (back) out vs. Raptors
articles.description: 76ers center Joel Embiid is questionable for Thursday night's game against the Raptors with right foot plantar fascia management. LeBron James is out with lower back/sciatica management.
articles.headlineJa: 76ersのジョエル・エンビード（足）は出場不透明、レブロン・ジェームズ（腰）はラプターズ戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: 76ersのセンター、ジョエル・エンビードは右足の足底筋膜の管理のため、木曜夜のラプターズ戦への出場が不透明です。レブロン・ジェームズは腰部および坐骨神経の管理のため欠場します。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid, who is questionable for Thursday night's game against the Toronto Raptors with right foot plantar fascia management, said he has "no idea" if he'll play.

"We'll see what they have to say and then we'll go from there," Embiid said, referring to the Sixers' medical staff.

LeBron James, who was ruled out with lower back/sciatica management, was among the last players on the floor after shootaround, taking free throws.

James, who turns 42 next month, will now have four to five days off before he plays again. The Sixers are off Friday and Saturday. They have back-to-back games Sunday and Monday. James typically does not play in least one game of a back-to-back set so he could return Sunday against Indiana or Monday at Brooklyn.

James has averaged 15.1 points, 7.2 rebounds and 6.5 assists in 10 games for the Sixers this season.

Embiid has missed two games this season to manage his fascia injury, and the Sixers are 1-1 in his absence.

The Sixers would be significantly shorthanded in the frontcourt if Embiid is out. Big man Adem Bona (cervical spine sprain) and Dominick Barlow (back) have already been ruled out.

On this new-look Sixers team, Embiid has struggled the most to look like himself. He's begun this season with averages in points (17.7) and three-point percentage (12.1%) that would be career lows.

"I just haven't been aggressive," he said Thursday. "So I think it's on me to just be aggressive about making plays, whether it's making plays for someone else."

Information from The Associated Press was used in this report.

articles.headline: Warriors' Stephen Curry out at least 2 weeks with oblique tear
articles.description: Warriors star Stephen Curry has an oblique abdominal tear and will be reevaluated in two weeks.
articles.headlineJa: ウォリアーズのステフィン・カリー、斜腹筋損傷のため少なくとも2週間の欠場へ
articles.descriptionJa: ウォリアーズのスター、ステフィン・カリーが斜腹筋を損傷。2週間後に経過を再評価する予定。
articles.body:
HOUSTON -- Golden State Warriors star Stephen Curry will miss at least two weeks after suffering an oblique abdominal tear, it was announced Thursday.

Curry exited Wednesday's loss to the Houston Rockets with 6:25 remaining in the first quarter and later had an MRI.

He started grabbing at his right side a few minutes into the game, attempting to play through the pain while sporadically looking over at the training staff. With 7:22 left in the first quarter, Curry came off a Draymond Green screen and nailed a 28-foot 3-pointer but yelled in pain after the release and signaled toward the bench.

Coach Steve Kerr said Curry told him the tweak of his side was an injury he hadn't felt before.

"Concern is high," Kerr said.

Curry will miss at least the next seven games against the San Antonio Spurs, New Orleans Pelicans, Dallas Mavericks, Memphis Grizzlies, Boston Celtics, Sacramento Kings and Portland Trail Blazers.

The Warriors (8-4) were down 19-10 when Curry exited, clawed back to tie it but ultimately lost by seven points, snapping an eight-game winning streak that had been spurred by a surging Curry, who is averaging 27.8 points in 26.3 minutes per game this season. 

He also is shooting a career-high 45.7% from 3-point range this season.

At halftime, prior to leaving the arena for an MRI, Curry spoke to his teammates, told them to focus on the task at hand and assured them that he would get through this latest injury fine.

This is the latest blow to an already depleted Warriors team. Starting wings Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody are out rehabbing long-term knee injuries. Projected starting center Kristaps Porzingis stepped away from the team and sport entirely. Backup guard Brandon Williams strained a hamstring and will miss at least a week.

The Warriors were 13-26 in the 39 games that Curry missed last season. This season, they are 1-1 without Curry, who also is averaging 3.9 assists and 3.7 rebounds.

"The spirit of this team is better," Green said. "We're more certain of who we are, what makes us a good team. I think that puts us in a better position to be successful without him as opposed to where we were last year. Then obviously [Yaxel Lendeborg], having a guy you can give the ball to and he can create an advantage. [Brandin Podziemski] is playing a lot better. ... It puts us in a better position."

articles.headline: Pierre Sage sacked with Crystal Palace bottom of Premier League
articles.description: Pierre Sage has been dismissed as Crystal Palace manager after a disappointing start to the season.
articles.headlineJa: クリスタル・パレスがプレミアリーグ最下位となり、ピエール・セージ監督を解任
articles.descriptionJa: 今シーズンの不本意な滑り出しを受け、ピエール・セージがクリスタル・パレスの監督を解任された。
articles.body:
Crystal Palace have sacked manager Pierre Sage after just five months in charge with the side rock bottom of the Premier League, the club have confirmed.

Sage, hired in the summer as the replacement for Oliver Glasner, lost his job barely an hour after Michael Carrick was sacked by Manchester United. They are the first two Premier League managers to be sacked this season.

Palace have just two wins from 10 games in England's top flight, with a 2-1 loss to Liverpool on Sunday -- their fourth straight defeat in the league - leaving the team in last place on seven points. 

It is the first time the club has been bottom of the Premier League after a complete round of games since 2017. Palace have also won just one of their four matches in the Europa League.

In a club statement, Palace said: "Crystal Palace Football Club can confirm that Pierre Sage has left his role as Manager.

"Three members of Pierre's coaching staff -- Jamal Alioui, Damien Della Santa and Sandy Guichard -- have also left the club.

"The club would like to place on record its thanks to Pierre and his staff for their efforts during their time in South London, and wish them well for the future.

"An update on the process of appointing a new Manager will be provided in due course."

Sage arrived from Lens in June and had the daunting task of succeeding Oliver Glasner, who established himself as a club great after leading Palace to three trophies in two years: The FA Cup, the Community Shield and the Conference League.

Before that, Palace had never won a major trophy.

Sage was partly hired because he deployed the same 3-4-3 formation as Glasner, but the club hasn't backed the Frenchman with a deep enough squad to handle a tough schedule that mostly demands a game every three or four days because of Europa League commitments.

The departure of key defenders Maxence Lacroix, to Chelsea, and Daniel Muñoz, who followed Glasner to Nottingham Forest, has weakened the backline, and continued the theme of Palace being unable to keep hold of all of its best players.

- Michael Carrick sacked by Man United, sources say Mauricio Pochettino close

- Crystal Palace appeal over Jean-Philippe Mateta red card rejected

- Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool to battle for Scott signature

Other Palace stars departing in recent years include Michael Olise, Eberechi Eze and Marc Guéhi

Sage arrived in south London after an impressive spell at Lens, where he secured a second-place Ligue 1 finish and won the Coupe de France.

He had previously managed Lyon, guiding the French club away from relegation trouble and into European competition.

The Associated Press contributed to this report.

What you need to know for Thursday

Coming off a 43-point performance against the Indiana Pacers, Cooper Flagg and the Dallas Mavericks visit the Minnesota Timberwolves in one of the top matchups on Thursday's four-game slate. Dallas (7-4) has won three straight, and Minnesota (8-3) has won four in a row despite injuries to Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo. LaMelo Ball and Ayo Dosunmu have helped pick up the slack, as the pair combined for 50 points against the Utah Jazz on Sunday.

The Detroit Pistons visit the Washington Wizards just three days after beating them 122-111. Detroit (7-3) will again be without Jalen Duren, while Daniss Jenkins looks to build on Monday's performance when he finished with 22 points, eight assists and four steals. Elsewhere, the Philadelphia 76ers (9-3) host a Toronto Raptors team playing its second game in as many nights without Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard.

Let's take a closer look at Thursday's matchups, along with some fantasy streamers and betting angles worth considering.

Fantasy stream team

Players available in at least 50% of leagues

 Jakob Poeltl, C, Raptors (45.3%)

Poeltl has played at least 31 minutes in three straight games -- a positive sign after his minutes were limited earlier this season -- and averaged 14.3 PPG, 9.0 RPG and 2.0 blocks during that stretch. The 76ers have Joel Embiid in their frontcourt, so Toronto will need Poeltl's size. He's worth streaming for rebounds, blocks and field-goal percentage, although his six-point performance against the Boston Celtics on Wednesday is a reminder that his scoring can fluctuate.

 Paul Reed, PF/C, Pistons (37.2%)

Reed remains viable with Duren sidelined, particularly for managers chasing rebounds and defensive stats. He has pulled down 10-plus rebounds in consecutive games, including Monday's matchup against the Wizards when he also recorded three blocks and a steal. Reed averages 11.4 PPG and 7.4 RPG this season, but he moved to the bench Monday and played just 21 minutes, which limits his ceiling. Still, he's worth considering in category leagues, especially if the Pistons give him additional frontcourt minutes.

 Grayson Allen, SG/PG, Charlotte Hornets (25.8%)

Allen should continue to have a significant role in Charlotte's offense with Kon Knueppel, Brandon Miller and Dennis Schroder sidelined. He finished with 52 fantasy points in 34 minutes against the Cleveland Cavaliers on Monday. Allen's usage rate reached 24% in that game, and he averages 3.5 made three-pointers per game this season. articles.headline: Barcelona fan for life -- and beyond: Fans can pay to deposit ashes at Camp Nou
articles.description: Barcelona are giving their fans the possibility to be part of the club once they pass away by offering from 2027 a columbarium and commemorative plaques at their stadium.
articles.body:
Barcelona are giving their fans the possibility to be part of the club once they pass away by offering from 2027 a columbarium and commemorative plaques at their stadium.

As part of the upgrade to Camp Nou, Barça will have a 1,500m² Memorial space consisting of commemorative plaques and 26,000 niches, where fans' ashes can be deposited.

Both the columbarium and commemorative plaques come with concessions lasting for 10, 25 or 50-year periods. Both options are available to Barça fans worldwide as there is no need to be a club member.

"Two ways of paying tribute and showing remembrance will be available through placing a loved one's ashes in a columbarium or writing a name and message on a commemorative plaque in the Stadium. Both options are available to FC Barcelona fans worldwide, there is no need to be a member," a club statement said.

A peaceful resting place at the Camp Nou will cost from €2,490 ($2,762) for a 10-year concession while the 50-year concession will set you back €5,990 ($6,644). In addition, there is a maintenance fee of €70 per year. A standard 10-year plaque is €490 while a 50-year premium one is €1,040.

Designed by architect Quique Montoya, the Memorial space will combine "fine materials, warm lighting and a contemporary style, with large murals dedicated to notable moments in Barça's history, plus visual, audiovisual and sound elements."

The work, which is being carried out in two phases, will be completed in mid-2028.

"Many fans, members and those with a past at the Club have shown interest in the FC Barcelona Memorial since the launch of the project," the club said.

"These include several former players and relatives of historic figures at Barça who have shown their desire to form part of the initiative."
